    The Jacobson radical of a noncommutative local ring #

    In a Dedekind-finite local ring, the nonunits form a two-sided ideal. This is the unique maximal left ideal, and therefore agrees with the ring Jacobson radical. The Dedekind-finite hypothesis holds in particular for Artinian rings and for finite-dimensional algebras over a field.
